description: This is a test class for the Android widget configuration UI, verifying default settings, toggle behavior, and saving preferences.

classes.name: WidgetConfigTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for WidgetConfigActivity UI components and preferences handling.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test environment by clearing existing widget preferences.

methods.name: testDefaultSettings
methods.description: Verifies initial states of switches are checked by default.

methods.name: testToggleSettings
methods.description: Tests toggling switches and their resulting state changes.

methods.name: testSaveSettings
methods.description: Checks that preferences are saved correctly after clicking save.
